evidence_limits: This index is a derived summary, not raw observations or independent reexecution.
Public code and public committed synthetic fixtures can be reviewed independently.
Local-only raw studies require separate local evidence review; a matching hash by itself does not validate conclusions.
No model weights, media, player identities, credentials, raw private logs or machine paths are published.

timing_semantics.first_decision_ms: validation+request preparation+pre-forward journal fsync+worker IPC/inference; not pure NN; excludes final result journal persistence
timing_semantics.worker_ipc_ms: worker call elapsed including local transport and scorer; no pre-forward journal
timing_semantics.inference_ms: measured model scoring segment only on returned successful forwards
timing_semantics.cache: determinism reread separated, never counted as independent inference/timely coverage

specified_limp_then_min_raise.scope: Only this exact scripted prefix, not all second decisions
